verdict.rationale: Datalab docs explicitly describe 'Forge', a web playground where you upload a document and see parse/extract results instantly with no API key or code, and the changelog confirms structured extraction/track-changes results are previewable directly in the UI. This directly matches the story's drag-and-drop, no-code preview experience. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the playground UX (e.g. third-party walkthrough or screenshots) beyond vendor docs.
